canonical_name: Technology Assets Not Protected from Environmental Threats
description: Technology assets are not protected from environmental threats.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of physical security controls, inadequate climate control systems, missing fire suppression, absence of power protection (UPS/generators), flood risk mitigation gaps, and insufficient protection against natural disasters and environmental hazards.
